issues.source: 131 parasites 1 treasure ticks are one inch parasites drawn to the smell of valuable metals and gems they are chameleonic and change shape to mimic coins gemstones etc where they hibernate until a warm blooded victim becomes available if collected in a pouch with coins the bugs burrow out in 1 d 6 minutes entering the flesh of their victim to feed they secrete a leech like anaesthesia detecting a burrowing tick requires a perc check at disadvantage if undetected the tick causes blood poisoning 1 d 3 str and dex loss after 1 d 4 hours and a madness the effects do not subside until the bugs are removed which requires surgery int apothecary check causing 1 d 4 damage if unsuccessful the victim also suffers internal bleeding 2 flesh grubs are filthy two inch burrowing worms with wicked beaks they consume corpses from the inside kept warm by the foul gases they emit as they lay eggs and multiply infested corpses bloat as the fumes build rendering them liable to explode an int apothecary wilderness lore check might notice the tell tale flesh grubs odour if disturbed the corpse ruptures showering melee range with grubs which burrow for the heart a luck con save is required to avoid death in 1 d 4 rounds fire or acid kills the grubs but causes the victim 2 d 6 damage 3 throat leeches are fast swimming four inch marine parasites that lurk in water holes rivers and oceans a pc swimming in an infested area requires a luck save to avoid swallowing the horrible wrigglers on a failed save several leeches have entered the victim s throat and latched onto their gullet over the next 1 d 4 hours and each day afterwards the leeches feed causing 1 str or con loss even chance removing the leeches requires surgery or alchemical tinctures that are poisonous if not properly administered an int apothecary check kills the parasites in 1 d 3 days if failed the victim also suffers 2 d 4 damage a desperate victim might drink and regurgitate a issues.source: for gms running argosa in a west marches style with a potentially different mix of players each session it is often a requirement for the party to return to base at the end of a play session to ensure that the characters of those wanting to play next week are available to adventure and not stuck in the wilderness or mid dungeon a potential problem with this approach is that large amounts of precious session time can be spent returning from an adventure site when the players would rather be exploring the dungeon further the back to base rule circumvents this instead of playing out the return trip in the usual way each pc makes a luck save if successful the adventurer makes it home without incident if unsuccessful they make it home but must roll
for a setback deduct rations based on estimated travel days back to base

203 vampire vampires are wicked undead blood feeders that masquerade as humans living within the very towns they prey upon they are intelligent and present as cold clammy handed humans often physically beautiful with enticing voices some may control vermin bats and wolves and all drain a victim s lifeforce with their bite a fully drained victim dies or becomes a thrall under the vampire s command after a time the master may choose to release a thrall allowing it to mature into a full vampire vampires are conscious of creating too many rivals however and are territorial with respect to feeding grounds they are just as likely to destroy a thrall as release it a thrall s ability to move about in daylight however is often of great utility to its master vampires find the smell of garlic repugnant do not cast reflections in mirrors cannot enter a building without being invited and hiss loudly when forcefully presented with the icon of a good deity vampires are difficult to slay permanently but direct sunlight or a wooden stake to the heart generally work referee s call vampire 1 ac 13 hd 9 bite 1 d 12 drain 1 level until the end of the next downtime period nat 19 a thrall comes to the vampire s aid s 19 d 19 c 16 i 13 p 17 w 16 ch 16 l 10 climb norm undead off turn attacks immune to non magical weapons exc cold iron holy water charming voice 3 as gaze of beguilement int 18 regen 1 d 12 fire holy if reduced to zero hp a vampire turns to mist and flies to its coffin where it regenerates in 1 d 4 hours reac 2 3 enraged 4 5 hungry 6 8 malevolent 9 10 curious 11 12 lustful
